comments.value: (Honestly adding all the remaining Dynamic Bones scripts to the whitelist makes sense - if you're supporting the tool, support the whole thing if possible!)

Agree.  I made a post here about this as well (after this one, and probably in the wrong spot) : https://vrchat.canny.io/bug-reports/p/whitelist-dynamicboneplanecollider-component

AFAIK, the performance is comparable to a normal collider, I'd think.  Currently if you try to mimic this with a sphere collider, you need more, bigger colliders and even then it doesn't work right usually since the individual bones just slip around the sphere collider. :/ 

So, it would probably actually be *more* performant than the current sphere colliders, even if an individual plane collider is worse than a sphere.

details:
Unless this is so expensive on compute to destroy frames, this is a useful script that comes as part of Dynamic Bones and allows for stopping dynamic'd bones from going too far in one direction.

For example, this prevents hair clipping through the front of the body.
